benefits.name: 2% Executive reward
benefits.instructions: Earned automatically on qualified purchases, up to $1,250 a year; paid as a reward in the renewal statement about three months before renewal. Not on gas, tobacco, Costco Shop Cards or stamps.
benefits.source_excerpt: Executive Members earn an annual 2% Reward, up to $1,250*, on qualified Costco, Costco.com and Costco Travel purchases. ... Rewards are not calculated: (i) on purchases of cigarettes or tobacco-related products, gasoline, Costco Shop Cards, postage stamps
